errors.text_span: 而较小的饼图则展示了剩余类别的细分
errors.evidence: The smaller pie chart does not show a breakdown of the 'remaining categories'. It shows a detailed breakdown of one specific category from the main chart, which is '其他' (Other), accounting for 5.64%.
The chart displays 19 unique categories in total (5 in the main chart besides 'Other', and 14 in the exploded chart).
The color for the '其他' (Other) category is a gray-blue, not light green (浅绿色).
The color for the '判断' (Judgment) category is a light greenish-blue, not beige (米色).
The color for the '文教' (Culture/Education) category is gray, not light blue (浅蓝色).

The description incorrectly attributes the value and color of another category to '战争' (War). The correct value for '战争' is 0.6% and its color is red. The value 15.1% and the deep red/purple color belong to '争斗' (Struggle).
The smaller pie chart contains 14 subcategories, not 13.
The value for '争斗' (Struggle) is 15.1%, not 2.93%. The value 2.93% belongs to '帮助' (Help).
The color for the '管理' (Management) category is red, not brown (棕色).
The color for the '经贸' (Economy/Trade) category is light blue, not pale purple (淡紫色).
The color for the '社交' (Social) category is light blue, not light pink (浅粉色).
The color for the '帮助' (Help) category is light orange, not yellow (黄色).

errors.text_span: 而较小的饼图在右侧有一个图例，将每个类别与其对应的颜色和汉字标签进行匹配
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. Both charts have percentage labels directly on the chart. The legend on the right is a comprehensive legend for all categories across both charts, not just for the smaller pie chart.
The description lists only 9 of the 14 categories present in the smaller pie chart. It omits '心理活动' (15.44%), '司法' (14.57%), '文教' (10.98%), '物态事态' (6.72%), and '战争' (0.6%).

This sentence incorrectly groups categories from both the main pie chart and the exploded sub-chart into a single list, creating a confusing and structurally inaccurate representation of the data. It implies these are all peer categories.
